tierTotals.confidence: high (PowerPyx summary counts match the per-trophy tiers from GTABase exactly)

findings.name: Tier assignment source
findings.detail: Per-trophy tiers for all 28 non-platinum trophies come from GTABase (tier/points table). PowerPyx independently states tiers for 14 entries (Plat + Gold: Without a Scratch, Wheels Up, Furious First Responder, Liberty City Secrets, Is That All You've Got?; Silver: Mob Boss, Planned Ahead, Got This Figured Out, Man Toyz, Splish Splash, Playing Doctor, Going Rogue, Where To?) and its totals (1/6/11/11) match. Entries I rate medium have only the GTABase tier. PSNProfiles/TrueTrophies pages were not retrievable.

findings.name: Missable trophies
findings.detail: PowerPyx flags 5 as missable: Without a Scratch, Mob Boss, Planned Ahead, Got This Figured Out, Is That All You've Got? (the last is reported glitched; leaving 'Kingdom Come' as the final 100% item can stop it from popping).

findings.name: Cheats disable trophies
findings.detail: Using cheats disables trophies in the Definitive Edition (unlike the old PS4 port).

xboxCrossCheck.summary: Xbox has 28 achievements totalling 1000 Gamerscore (no Platinum equivalent). Names and descriptions match the PlayStation list one-to-one for entries 1-28 per GTABase and gta.wiki. Gamerscore values (GTABase, no second source): First Day on the Job 15; Without a Scratch 40; Escape Artist 25; Disposing of the Evidence 15; Mob Boss 45; Street Sweeper 25; Planned Ahead 40; Got This Figured Out 45; By a Mile 30; Wreckless Driving 25; Wheels Up 50; Come Out to Play-y-y-y 25; Where To? 50; Liberty City Minute 50; Full Artillery 25; A Marked Man 25; Offshore Delivery 25; Not So Fast 25; A Gift from the King 25; Man Toyz 30; Splish Splash 30; Playing Doctor 35; Going Rogue 30; Dirty Money 30; Right-hand Man 25; Furious First Responder 55; Liberty City Secrets 60; Is That All You've Got? 100. Sum verified = 1000.

versionNotes.note: The 29-entry PlayStation list (28 + Platinum) is the Definitive Edition list. GTABase/gta.wiki also list 15 extra 'Social Club' accomplishments (#30-44: Got Any Stories, Old Man?; Talks a Lot; Blood in the Streets; Instigator; Chasing Paper; Am Walkin' Here; Hunting Season; Repeat Offender; Cheaters Do Prosper!; Play Fetch; Pest Control; Relief Pitcher; Like a Boss; Fare Game; Recycler). These are NOT PSN trophies and have no tier; they inflate the '44 total' quoted by some sites. PowerPyx confirms only 29 trophies on PlayStation.

The old 2015 PS4 GTA III port had its own 29-trophy list; it is a different list (gta.wiki: Splish Splash and Going Rogue then required 20, now 15; 'Population Control' and 'Where we're going, we don't need roads' were dropped; 'If You Ain't Cheatin', You Ain't Tryin'' renamed 'Cheaters Do Prosper!' and moved to Social Club).
Platinum 'King of Liberty City' is PlayStation-only; Xbox and Switch have no equivalent natively. On Social Club it requires all other 43 accomplishments in one playthrough.
Digital PS4/PS5 version is cross-buy eligible; physical disc is not (PowerPyx). Estimated 4/10 difficulty, 20-25 hours.
